content: Abuse: Gmail sender rules require SPF/DKIM (+DMARC for bulk >=5k/day), spam complaint rate kept under 0.3%; one-click unsubscribe for marketing mail only. Magic links are consumed by enterprise mail scanners that prefetch URLs; fix is a landing page that redeems the token only on a user POST, plus a code fallback. User-content hosting gets whole domains flagged by Safe Browsing. DSA: Art. 19 exempts micro/small enterprises from the online-platform section only; hosting-service duties such as Art. 16 notice-and-action still apply (reading of the text, secondary confirmation only).
